question: Can a deterministic shared two-bit word encoder attain both frozen, bounded #09 decision targets?
direction_selected_before_new_table: J=0 by geometry alone: first axis (z) at normal -2 relative to tile origin, leaving plane z=-1 unseen. Tangential offsets (y,x)=(0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1) with weights (1,3,9,27). 2^3 visible species digits 0/1/2 in (z,y,x) lexicographic order, x fastest, weights 3^0 through 3^7. Exactly all 8000 periodic origins per 20^3 parent. No choices among directions after scoring.
provenance: Native b09 TRAIN only in the registered tranche2 bank. Rows [0,4096) fit; [4096,4608) development; [4608,5120) audit, only after public design AND artifact lock and explicit release. These were historically reused TRAIN, not independent of the old payoffs and maps. No historical pooled face table, native validation, TEST, cold reserve or other endpoint. Equal parent and origin weights.
witness: fifteen/09-witness.npz, SHA256 ce6de1b599bd8a7a19d3af88a54658a327264ebb5b3382fb1424f97c8c162363. Use saved payoff[t,0,y,a], maps[t,v], policies[t,t,0,h], t=0 discrete and t=1 affine. Matched targets on each split are those fixed, historically deployed policies on the respective payoff. No refit of target policies or post-hoc maximizing over incumbents.
certificate: Weight each utility 1/2. For each sorted lexicographic size-4 subset of the 16 pairs i=4*a_discrete+a_affine, sum over v the maximum, over its menu, of the fit joint-count weighted payoff. All C(16,4)=1820 menus; every smaller menu can be padded. First maximizing entry and first maximizing menu on ties, including zero-fit-count words to first menu entry. For unequivocal parity use the exact binary rationals represented by the saved float64 payoffs (scale by the largest power-of-two denominator, use arbitrary-precision integers). Deploy the exact achieving LUT of length 6561 and its two policies. This constructive value is both lower and upper support on THIS named finite fit table; compare to half-sum of its two matched targets. Positive target-minus-support gap excludes exact simultaneous achievement; gap >0.001 excludes both within 0.001 on that table. A nonpositive gap does not establish individual feasibility; always show each utility and deficit. Never turn this into a population upper bound.
development_and_audit: Freeze without development tuning. For each held-apart split evaluate two separate bounded achieved and target utilities, their paired target-minus-achieved deficits and equal-weight average by independent whole parent. Report two-sided individual 95% t intervals for means and simultaneous two-sided 95% Bonferroni paired t intervals for the two deficits (97.5% marginal). Both upper bounds <=0.001 support practical joint attainment by this fixed compromise; any lower bound >0.001 is a practically missed target by this code only. No held-out reoptimization. Also report the same map and policies applied unchanged across six directions with the original matching directional payoffs and historical target policies, labeled only an achievable all-six lower bound, not an all-six optimum. No new six-direction fitting.
sizing_projection: 32,768,000 fit opportunities, 4,096,000 each in development and audit, 6561x81 exact counts; positive support counts reported. 1820*6561*4=47,764,080 candidate values across words and menus; 512 independent evaluation clusters, not four million. Ideal 80% detection of deficit 0.001 at two-sided Bonferroni per-utility alpha=.025 requires about SD <=0.00734 across parent paired differences (normal approximation); refine prospective audit halfwidth from dev SD. Any excess uncertainty reported.
controls: Exhaustively compare a tiny menu solution with all small label maps plus optimal per-label policies; tie/unseen and duplicate-action padding; independent explicit periodic word/face coordinates including boundary anchors; rescore winning fit LUT and matched targets by action, check equality with enumeration and denominator.
